# 8.css

> Lightweight CSS-only UI library inspired by Windows 8 Modern UI / Start Screen and Windows 8 desktop.

8.css styles semantic HTML without requiring JavaScript at runtime and can be used with any framework that loads CSS.

## Rules
- Use w8- for public component classes.
- Edit src/8.css and run npm run build to regenerate dist/8.css.
- Keep Start Screen and desktop styles distinct.
- Keep README, docs/components.md, AGENTS.md, and llms-full.txt synchronized.
- Do not claim CSS implements application behavior.

## Components
Start Screen: w8-start-screen, w8-start-heading, w8-start-subtitle, w8-tiles, w8-tile and size/color modifiers.
Controls: w8-button, w8-input, w8-select, w8-textarea, w8-check, w8-radio, w8-choice, w8-toggle.
Feedback/navigation: w8-progress, w8-badge, w8-notice, w8-divider, w8-tabs, w8-tab.
Desktop: w8-window, w8-title-bar, w8-window-body, w8-window-footer, w8-app-bar, w8-dialog.

API status: early foundation; src/8.css is the implementation source.
